steps.note: Remove any invalid leftover of this index from an earlier interrupted CONCURRENTLY build (none exists now; no-op). Alone in its step: CONCURRENTLY cannot run inside a transaction block.
steps.sql: DROP INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF EXISTS orders_customer_id_idx;

steps.note: Build the index without blocking the app's inserts/reads. (customer_id, id) serves WHERE customer_id = $1 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 10 directly: an index scan backwards, no sort. Takes a SHARE UPDATE EXCLUSIVE lock only, which does not conflict with INSERT/SELECT.
steps.sql: CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY orders_customer_id_idx ON orders (customer_id, id);

steps.note: Fail the plan if the build left the index invalid (e.g. it was cancelled), so it never silently goes unused.
steps.sql: DO $$ BEGIN IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_index WHERE indexrelid = 'orders_customer_id_idx'::regclass AND indisvalid AND indisready) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'orders_customer_id_idx is not valid'; END IF; END $$;
